description: Defines the Appointment data model class with fields for appointment details, along with factory and toMap methods for serialization and deserialization.

classes.name: Appointment
classes.description: A data model representing an appointment with fields for id, patient, doctor, start and end times, status, and notes. Includes factory method fromMap for creating an instance from a map, and toMap for serialization.

methods.name: Appointment.fromMap
methods.description: Factory constructor that creates an Appointment instance from a map, parsing date strings into DateTime objects, and handling optional fields.

methods.name: toMap
methods.description: Converts the Appointment instance into a map suitable for serialization or API transmission.
